config.name: B - dense
config.notes: The Phase 1 baseline. Everything after is measured against this.

config.name: C - dense + context
config.notes: Adds the document title to each chunk before embedding. Isolates the fix for the measured multi-hop failure: a passage describing an achievement says nothing about whose it is.

config.name: D - hybrid RRF
config.notes: Adds the lexical arm, fused by rank. Isolates what fusion contributes.

config.name: L - lexical only
config.notes: A control rather than an arm: it shows what dense retrieval is buying, and which items it alone loses.
